title: Resolving Collisions
summary: Knowing two things overlap is half the job; the other half is deciding what happens. This lesson pushes objects apart along the shortest way out, moves one axis at a time so characters slide along walls, and stops fast objects from tunnelling through thin walls.

cards.q: Which axis do you push an object out along?
cards.a: The one where the overlap is smaller: the shortest way out.

cards.q: Why move and resolve one axis at a time?
cards.a: The direction of each single-axis move tells you which side was hit, characters slide along walls, and they do not catch on seams between tiles.
A fast object jumping completely past a thin obstacle between two frames, so no overlap is ever detected.
